run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit of the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' across the four namespaces whose names begin with 'app-283' (found via a cluster-wide namespace query: app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search). A ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' exists in each of the four namespaces, and each one's 'audit_code' key was read successfully. Summary of audit codes: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q; app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V; app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z; app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. All four ConfigMaps also carry the same sibling keys (owner=platform-team, tier=standard). Every namespace that starts with 'app-283' in the cluster had a matching ConfigMap, so no namespace was left without a code. Caveat: these reads are the cluster's object state at query time (2026-11-21T09:16:19Z-09:16:22Z), not a historical snapshot, and ConfigMap data is not secret material here, so the values could be read directly. No fault, error or alert was being investigated; this was a configuration inventory only.
